$comment: Declared versions NOT published from this repository, each with the reason.
State is computed from this repository's git tags. a1 and a2 were published
from dotmac_starter_mt and their tags stay there permanently.
0.1.0a3 is NOT listed here and that is deliberate: it IS published, so it is
not an unpublished declaration. It carries no tag because its verification
returned UNPROVABLE, and `docs/published-versions.json` records it as
immutable and never pinnable. A row here would say the opposite of the truth.

0.1.0a4.reason: Supersedes 0.1.0a3, which was published by a run cancelled during its own verify job and is permanently UNPROVABLE. a4 is published by a fresh protected-main run on the corrected workflow, and tagged only after authenticated read-back, exact hash equality over every built artifact, and clean consumer installation all succeed.
